rationale: Ogles keeps Trump's endorsement, but Jul 13-20 reports (Tennessean, WPLN, Banner) show a closer race: Hatcher out-raised him ($187k cash vs Ogles $67k + $70k debt), was endorsed by Haslam (Jul 16), Perdue, Corker and Wamp, and his internal poll shows a 'virtual tie'; 83% of voters are new to the redrawn district. Early voting runs Jul 17-Aug 1.

No foreign trip reported as of Jul 21. On Jul 17 Ye Win Oo inspected the first-ever Myanmar-Russia joint exercise (Tiger-2026) in Naypyitaw and cited regular reciprocal visits by the two armed forces' chiefs, so Russia gets a slight edge over China.

No UKAD ruling yet. In Dec 2025 Parker asked 'Why did I have that cup of tea?' On Jul 8 2026 adviser Spencer Brown cited 'contamination', 'the people around him at the time' and witness statements, and expects a reduced ban, which points to third-party contamination of a drink or contact.

On Jul 21 AJK Chief Election Commissioner Ghulam Mustafa Mughal announced a three-phase poll (Tribune, The News, Daily Pakistan): Mirpur Division Jul 27, Muzaffarabad Division plus refugee seats Aug 2, and Poonch Division (Poonch/Rawalakot, Bagh, Sudhnoti, Haveli) Aug 10, with postponement calls rejected. The small residual covers a further delay in unrest-hit Rawalakot/Sudhnoti.

June report (Jul 2): leisure and hospitality -61k, information -9k, trade/transportation/utilities -4k (retail -7.5k), mining -4k, financial activities flat after -22k in May; the labour force is shrinking. Subsectors count within parents, so Retail trade was replaced by Trade, transportation, and utilities; volatile large sectors are favoured for the biggest July decline.
Dolphin had not formed as of Jul 21 (Noul made landfall in Guangdong around Jul 21; Bavi in Zhejiang on Jul 11), so there is no track information; keeping the diffuse Zhejiang/Fujian/Guangdong prior.
Three searches and the local archive found no reporting on the boat Kate or a UK Freedom Flotilla departure as of Jul 21; keeping the prior.

Marc Marquez dominated the German GP on Jul 12 (sprint and GP double, his 3rd GP win in 4 races) and is 18 pts behind leader Martin (5th). Ogura has 3 straight podiums. Bezzecchi, the 2025 Silverstone winner, fractured his collarbone in Sachsenring qualifying ('complicated' surgery plus a Jul 18 knee procedure); he targets an Aug 9 return but has scored only 13 of 148 points in 4 rounds.

No 2026 reports of any country moving to recognise Israeli sovereignty over the Golan. Milei's April 2026 Israel visit only reiterated the embassy move; Syria's Sharaa reasserted the claim on Apr 19. Keeping the prior led by Argentina.

Trump gave Marques a 'Complete and Total Endorsement' on Jun 22, adding to Britt, Speaker Ledbetter and ALFA. He was the only candidate on TV ($200k+ buy, Jul 14) and led the June poll 30-10. The Aug 11 special primary is plurality with no runoff.

Jul 17-20: journalist Ihor Burbas (who first broke the Brentford talks) says the 17k Gtech was dropped as too small and Shakhtar is choosing between Stamford Bridge (40k) and Craven Cottage. The Athletic/Standard (Jul 19-20) say Chelsea, Fulham and Brentford were all contacted, Chelsea is keen for revenue, and a decision is imminent.

Reuters Jul 20: the Danube at Romania's entry point fell to 1,700 m3/s (lowest since 1996), and reservoirs are being managed to keep minimum cooling levels for Cernavoda's two units. Nuclearelectrica (Jul 11) said both run at full power, with shutdown thresholds of 2.50/2.35 mdMB in the intake basin (precedent: 2003). Rain was expected to give a temporary rise.

No new 2026 Redd Barna statement found. In Aug 2025 its IHL adviser Mads Harlem reacted 'especially strongly' to NBIM's ICL (white phosphorus) stake; Next Vision (IDF drone cameras) was still held at end-2025 per the Palestine Committee.

Reuters Jul 17 and Maritime Executive/NSJ Jul 21: the Caroline Bezengi ran aground on Al Qibliyah (Hallaniyat Islands, off Dhofar, Oman) and is breaking up. Sentinel images Jul 2-13 show a slick in this protected area, and Oman surveyed the ship on Jul 12. Contamination is expected to reach the Dhofar coast; the island exclusion fits this location.

Miami host San Luis (Aug 5), Monterrey (Aug 8; just signed Cuypers) and Leon (Aug 12); only the top 4 of 18 MLS clubs advance. Messi and De Paul are on post-World Cup vacation (Miami Herald Jul 21) and may return for the Aug 5 opener. No basis to change.

BBC (Jul 21) confirmed the bracket: SF1 = (A1 v B2) v (D1 v C2), SF2 = (B1 v A2) v (C1 v D2), so likely group winners Morocco and Nigeria are on opposite sides. Favourites are Nigeria, Morocco (hosts, runners-up 2022 and 2025), South Africa, Ghana and Zambia. The tournament starts Jul 26.

Jul 14: the National Assembly (Jorge Rodriguez) and Figuera's 2015-AN opposition announced formal talks from Aug 1 (Rubio Jul 20: first week of August). Their stated priority is 'strengthening the electoral system'; Figuera returned to push CNE renewal and outlets headline 'reforma electoral'. The TSJ is also on the agenda, so Judicial is the main alternative.
